en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a monument in a park-like setting, surrounded by large trees. At the base of the monument, several people, including children and adults, are gathered, some posing for the photograph. The monument itself features a statue of a seated man on a pedestal, with a female figure reaching up towards him. Text at the bottom identifies the location and the subject of the statue.
